scope: Independent source/schema fidelity review of proposed EXT-F-4137-T01, EXT-F-4138-T01, and EXT-F-4141-T01 procedures. No runtime execution.

verdict_A.label: PASS
verdict_A.summary: The procedures describe source-supported manual executions and distinguish those results from dispatcher/auth behavior and durable cloud state.
evidence: ToolsView.tsx parses JSON (blank becomes {}), validates local handler Zod args, then calls handler.run directly with permissionMode=act and assignedTabId=null; it does not run the dispatcher gate.

guidance.ts requires nonempty domain/text on save, but list_guidance domain is optional; an empty string takes the unfiltered branch. Guidance storage writes item and index locally before fire-and-forget cloud sync; delete removes local state before fire-and-forget cloud delete.

Highlight list accepts page/site/all and positive limits up to 1000; explicit URL bypasses assigned-tab lookup. Page query matches exact URL; site derives hostname and matches exact stored domain. Read errors return []; malformed rows are skipped.
Proposed procedures include owned IDs/fixtures, valid positive assertions, negative input checks, reloads, exact-target cleanup, and explicit limits on cloud/auth conclusions.

verdict_B.label: PASS
verdict_B.summary: Review package preserves separate behavior and quality judgments, does not convert source review into runtime evidence, and avoids broad cleanup or inferred access results.
evidence: Unfiltered guidance reads are explicitly redacted in retained evidence; highlight absence is not accepted as proof of access denial or successful database reads.
Cloud durability and deletion claims require exact-ID observation or independent same-principal hydration; failures and unresolved cleanup remain open by ID.
Procedure calls are limited to three existing inventory cases; no behavior or permissions are invented for highlight listing.

precise_findings.finding: The proposal's parent-domain guidance assertion is source-correct but easy to read backwards: a note saved on procedure-guidance.invalid matches a filter of sub.procedure-guidance.invalid; the inverse is not guaranteed.
precise_findings.disposition: Current step uses the correct direction; preserve that exact fixture/filter pairing.

precise_findings.finding: Highlight query source declares the table as extend.wbx_highlight and uses the current client query path, while the checked-in historical migration describes an older public.wbx_highlight shape. Source inspection cannot certify deployed schema, live RLS policy, or current backend rows.
precise_findings.disposition: Keep the proposed live exact-ID row check and RLS caveat; do not treat the migration mirror or inventory metadata as live-schema proof.

precise_findings.finding: The manual runner's direct handler call means its action/read result does not establish permission-gate behavior, advertised agent execution, guest access, or member/admin authorization differences.
precise_findings.disposition: Already stated in shared setup and unresolved dimensions; keep dispatcher/auth coverage separate.

precise_findings.finding: Guidance save/delete returns local handler success before asynchronous cloud work settles. Reload in the same profile only demonstrates local persistence; local get/list cannot verify the cloud row or tombstone.
precise_findings.disposition: The proposal correctly requires independent exact-ID cloud evidence for cloud claims and tracks unresolved cleanup.

precise_findings.finding: A missing highlight in list output can result from a failed query (empty array) or dropped malformed row, not only absence or RLS. The tool does not expose a success/error distinction for the underlying read.
precise_findings.disposition: The proposal correctly requires independent fixture-row confirmation and rejects empty-list-only access conclusions.

verification_limits: No browser, build, tests, database access, or runtime execution performed, as required by the review lane.
Live binding, deployed schema/RLS, actual role behavior, extension permissions, sync completion, and cleanup outcomes remain unverified.
